description: Deterministic infrastructure fault contracts for the maintained PostgreSQL, Kafka, Pi Worker and Cube Tool path.

cases.test: rolls readiness and family closure back together and ignores duplicate seals
cases.invariant: A failed seal commit cannot release the next Lane task or decrement the family count; replay decrements once.

cases.test: does not lose readiness when acceptance races closure: input-first
cases.invariant: Input acceptance and seal projection serialize on the Lane row and cannot leave a committed follow-up permanently waiting.

cases.test: does not lose readiness when acceptance races closure: seal-first
cases.invariant: Input waiting behind a seal transaction observes the committed closure and becomes ready without another notification.

cases.test: keeps every active Lane of one physical Pi Session on its owner Worker
cases.invariant: A ready main Lane cannot acquire a new owner until the old sibling's final seal commits.

cases.test: evicts committed message spans before Run completion and preserves a repeated unfinished prefix
cases.invariant: Committed text leaves live memory before the Run ends; an unfinished suffix remains exact after failure.

cases.test: discards an interrupted snapshot and applies only the complete replacement
cases.invariant: A partial snapshot never appears in the browser or leaks into the replacement snapshot.

cases.test: deduplicates the same command and reuses one execution promise
cases.invariant: Duplicate delivery does not execute one Agent command twice.

cases.test: retains the high-water fencing token after a pre-start release
cases.invariant: A released task cannot reuse its execution reference under a retired Session owner.

cases.test: retains tenant, writer, event identity and partition checks
cases.invariant: Only the recorded execution scope is projectable; no standalone opening is required.

cases.test: does not rewind canonical state on old append replay without a second receipt ledger
cases.invariant: Kafka redelivery creates one canonical Pi Session mutation.

cases.test: waits for ordered projection, saves the visible prefix and rejects a late old writer in both paths
cases.invariant: A replacement Worker observes every older accepted Session mutation before reading context.

cases.test: commits a complete assistant message independently of public event delivery
cases.invariant: A live-stream failure cannot roll back a complete native Pi message.

cases.test: runs claimed Parent/Child Lanes with PG projection paused, then cold-restores on a replacement Host
cases.invariant: A browser-visible interrupted prefix remains model-visible after Worker replacement.

cases.test: keeps an in-flight snapshot when committed content is evicted
cases.invariant: Terminal projection unloads shared live-tail memory without invalidating an in-flight browser snapshot.

cases.test: rebuilds an interrupted prefix after consumer restart, never duplicates a semantic append
cases.invariant: A replacement Projector reconstructs the unsealed prefix without repeating native mutations.

cases.test: co-commits the first native floor and replays after after_commit failure
cases.invariant: A lost PG COMMIT reply preserves the first recovery floor and idempotent native projection.

cases.test: co-commits the first native floor and replays after before_commit failure
cases.invariant: First native data and its recovery floor roll back together, and retry cannot skip the prefix.

cases.test: keeps an active assignment alive while the Control Plane process is killed and replaced
cases.invariant: Control Plane process replacement does not revoke a healthy Agent Loop.

cases.test: uses PostgreSQL to reject an old socket after reconnecting through another replica
cases.invariant: A stale Worker Control Channel cannot reclaim current ownership.

cases.test: retires an abandoned pre-provision request without creating a Cube
cases.invariant: A Control Plane failure before provisioning cannot leak a requested development machine.

cases.test: fences an expired replica before a surviving owner stays Ready
cases.invariant: A replacement Tool Broker fences the expired owner before serving its Workspace runtime.

cases.test: destroys an uncertain VM without replaying a disconnected Tool command
cases.invariant: An ambiguous Tool transport never blindly replays an arbitrary command.

cases.test: separates compute on one Workspace and keeps each binding's explicit cwd
cases.invariant: Expiring a child's independent compute scope keeps the shared Volume and the active parent's runtime; each binding uses its own frozen cwd.

cases.test: revokes the Session lease before a provider stop failure escapes
cases.invariant: Cancellation revokes Tool authority before uncertain process cleanup returns.

cases.test: fails every binding when the shared physical Workspace runtime is lost
cases.invariant: Loss of one Workspace Cube cannot leave a surviving logical Tool binding.

cases.test: waits for the live Cube activation before purging POSIX Workspace data
cases.invariant: Workspace bytes are not deleted while a live Cube still owns the Volume.

cases.test: retries the same record after delivery ACK loss without duplicating its live event
cases.invariant: A failed owner delivery retries the same positioned record without emitting its live event twice; this test simulates PG/transport.

cases.test: stops a retired partition handler after a PG await, before UI or Tool delivery
cases.invariant: A no-longer-current consumer handler cannot continue live or Tool delivery after its pending PG operation completes.

cases.test: closes queued materialization before shutdown releases physical capacity
cases.invariant: Broker shutdown rejects pending VM creation before freeing existing capacity; it never launches the waiter during teardown.

cases.test: accounts for adopted machines above a lowered limit before admitting new work
cases.invariant: Existing adopted machines count against a lowered capacity; new work remains queued until a physical slot is free.
